notes.title: Bug Fix (v1.1.1)
notes.content:
- bug fix: game crash when groundhog see apple entering hole
- bug fix: apple disappear when a far-away raft destroyed
- bug fix: can't undo groundhog loop
- add undo delay (0.3s) after player input, to fix some undo-related bugs

notes.title: Controller Support (v1.1.0)
notes.content:
Now you can play Kiko with your controller! 

Other changes:
- ghost input fix (a bug sometimes cause Kiko couldn't stop walking) 
- thanks list update

notes.title: Box-Pushing Fest Demo - v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're back with a much more polished demo (v0.6.0) for Box-Pushing Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042167/67413455147c7c62de7ed8409fe8f52bf984b987.png[/img]

Here are some major changes:
[list]
[*] brand new opening animation, explaining Kiko's motivation of collecting apples
[*] brand new shark-theme soundtrack
[*] map layout update (Kiko island & shark island)
[*] new NPCs (the witch and bear friends)
[*] fast travel between (visited) islands
[*] visual updates (whirlpool, shark, level button)
[*] and our favorite, a lovely [b]apple counting[/b] feature
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042167/110650a67cfb323907e62091001e8b4c47b21b85.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading, and we hope you'll enjoy the updated demo :)

-Chao from PawPaw Games

notes.title: Kiko is at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042167/5d83e72ec37c06822df01b20b092b361d5568c33.png[/img]

Kiko is super excited to be part of Steam Next Fest! Please check out the demo if you haven't yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288470/Kikos_Apple_Adventure_Demo/

If you enjoy the demo, we’d love to hear your thoughts! Leaving a review not only helps us improve the game but also allows more players to discover Kiko's Apple Adventure. Your feedback means a lot!

Thanks for all the support! Cheers!

-Chao from PawPaw Games
